h1: Hop Inn Phayao — New, Clean, Affordable Rooms in Central Phayao Near the Lake
intro: If you want a place in central Phayao that simply delivers a brand-new, clean room, a comfortable bed and an easy-on-the-wallet price with no frills, Hop Inn Phayao is the name travellers pick without overthinking. It is a 2-star budget hotel by Hop Inn (Erawan Group) that follows the same formula at every branch: clean standard rooms, consistent pricing and free parking. This branch has 77 rooms on Tha Kwan Road in Tambon Wieng, near Kwan Phayao lake, the King Ngam Mueang Monument and Wat Si Khom Kham, with lake views from some rooms. Rooms start from about ฿650/night.

body.html: Hop Inn Phayao is one of Erawan Group's Hop Inn properties spread across Thailand's secondary cities. This branch sits on Tha Kwan Road in Tambon Wieng, in central Phayao, a short hop from Kwan Phayao lake. The brand's selling point is clear from the start: clean standard rooms at a steady price, with no frills that inflate the bill. It's a multi-storey building with a lift and 77 rooms, designed to be plain and easy to use. People driving through Phayao, business travellers, or anyone stopping a night before continuing to Chiang Rai or Nan tend to choose it because they know exactly what they'll get — no surprises.

Standard rooms come with either a Double bed or two single beds (Twin), and some rooms have a balcony. Inside you get air-conditioning, a fridge, a flat-screen TV, a work desk and a hot-water shower. The thing guests mention most is how new and clean the rooms feel, with comfortable beds — many reviews say they're cleaner than the price suggests, and a few higher-floor rooms even look out over Kwan Phayao. The trade-off is that rooms are genuinely plain: no decorative touches, no bathtub and no in-house breakfast. It's a good room at a good price, not a place to hang out in all day.
"New and clean, close to Kwan Phayao — you can walk out for food and a coffee. Staff were polite and helpful, parking was sufficient. For this price in the city centre, it's genuinely good value."

Service is another strong point for a budget hotel. Staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful, reception is open 24 hours, and there's CCTV that leaves guests feeling secure. Free on-site parking makes it very convenient for self-drivers. The limitation is that there is no breakfast, no restaurant and no swimming pool, and some small details — a bath mat or a few in-room extras — may be missing in some rooms. The upside is that you're in the heart of the city, with food stalls and cafés a short walk away for a morning meal.

The Tha Kwan Road location is a real highlight. It sits in central Phayao, near Kwan Phayao lake — just a few minutes' walk or drive to the waterfront. The King Ngam Mueang Monument, the lakeside promenade and Wat Si Khom Kham (home of the great Phra Chao Ton Luang) are all close by, with the lakeside evening market a short drive away. The overall score sits around 9.4 from 109 Trip.com reviews, with the standout categories being cleanliness (9.7) and location (9.7).

To be straight: Hop Inn isn't a boutique hotel or a lakeside resort, and there's no pool. The point some guests raise is that amenities score a little lower than the other categories (around 9.1), a few rooms could use a bath mat or extra in-room items, and the lake view is only from certain rooms, not all of them. If you want a full lakeside resort feel with a water view from every room, M2 Hotel Waterside or Naga Tara may suit you better. But if you want a new, clean, comfortable room with free parking near the lake, at the lowest price in town, this place does its job well and consistently.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you want a lake view, ask for a higher-floor room when you book or check in, since only some rooms have one. Lean on the central location — walk or drive to the Kwan Phayao waterfront, the King Ngam Mueang Monument, Wat Si Khom Kham and the local eateries. If you arrive by car, the free on-site parking is a genuine advantage. Booking direct through the Hop Inn app can be cheaper at times, but always compare with Agoda and Booking first. And since there's no breakfast, plan to head out for noodles or a morning bite by the lake.

Cleanliness and the central location are the real strengths, and some rooms even throw in a lake view — but you have to accept plain rooms with no frills, no breakfast, no pool, and a lake view that's only from certain rooms.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Hop Inn Phayao

faq.q: Where is Hop Inn Phayao, and is it near Kwan Phayao lake?
faq.a: It's at 53/11 Tha Kwan Road, Tambon Wieng, in central Phayao, near Kwan Phayao lake — a few minutes' walk or drive to the waterfront. The King Ngam Mueang Monument and lakeside promenade are about 5 minutes by car, Wat Si Khom Kham ~7 minutes, and Phayao Bus Terminal ~6 minutes — a central base with food and cafés within easy reach.

faq.q: How much is Hop Inn Phayao and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about ฿650/night for a Standard Double. There's also a Standard Twin (two single beds) and rooms with a balcony. On long weekends or festivals the rate rises to around ฿890 and rooms sell out fast. Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Hop Inn Phayao best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for anyone who wants a new, clean, comfortable room at a light price with free parking. It suits people driving through Phayao, business travellers, or those stopping a night before continuing to Chiang Rai or Nan — anyone valuing consistency and a central location near the lake over a resort feel or a pool.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Hop Inn Phayao really new and clean — and do they have a lake view?
faq.a: The rooms feel new and very clean, with comfortable beds — the point guests agree on most (cleanliness 9.7). Some higher-floor rooms look out over Kwan Phayao, but not all do, so ask when you book. The trade-off is plain rooms with no decorative touches or bathtub, and a few rooms lack a bath mat or extras — just ask the 24h reception.

There is free private parking, very convenient for self-drivers, plus 24-hour reception and CCTV. However, there's no breakfast, no restaurant and no swimming pool. The upside is the central location near the lake, with food stalls and cafés a short walk away for a morning meal.

faq.q: What chain is Hop Inn, and is it reliable?
faq.a: Hop Inn is Erawan Group's budget hotel chain, with many branches across Thailand's secondary cities. Its strength is consistently clean rooms at steady prices everywhere. This Phayao branch scores around 9.4 from 109 Trip.com reviews, led by cleanliness (9.7) and location (9.7).
